metadata.title: Open Market Note #003 — ENTSO-E Imbalance Price Duration Baseline
metadata.description:
13-month empirical baseline for 15-min imbalance price duration, shortage vs surplus runs, and TSO incentive windows across ENTSO-E zones (NL, BE, FR, DK1, DK2, AT).

Package contains documentation (README.md), parameter ledger (PARAMS.md), reproducible python code, summary results (results.json), figures, data manifest (data_manifest.json).

Source Data Attribution: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform Terms of Use Item #27 (CC BY 4.0 Verbatim, https://transparency.entsoe.eu/content/static_content/html/terms_of_use.html)
